 Order on Board

1.

This is the first bail application filed by the applicant for grant of anticipatory bail in connection
with Crime No.95/2023 registered at Police Station Balrampur, District - Balrampur - Ramanujganj
(Chhattisgarh) for the offence punishable under Sections 294 and 376 of the Ipc.
2.

As per the prosecution story, on 17.08.2023 the victim lodged the FIR to the effect that the present applicant on pretext of marriage sexually assaulted her from 25.12.2016 to 20.06.2023 and thereafter he refused to marry.
On such complaint police registered the offence as stated above.
3. Learned counsel for the applicant would submit that at the time of lodging of FIR the age of the victim was 28 years and in the year 2016 she was aged about 21 years.
He would submit that there was no promise to marry and there was a consensual relationship between them and both were in a live-in relationship and they were residing in rented house.
He would further submit that applicant and the victim both belong to a different caste.
He would also submit that the victim was a grown up lady and she was well aware of pros and cons of such relationship.
Thus, he would pray for grant of anticipatory bail.
4. On the other hand, learned counsel for the State would oppose.
He would submit that on pretext of marriage, for several years the present applicant sexually exploited the victim.
The victim in her statement recorded under Sections 161 and 164 of the Cr.P.C.
has made serious allegations against the present applicant.
He would pray to reject the application.

sentences.text: 5. I have heard learned counsel for the parties and perused the case diary.

6. Taking into consideration the fact that the FIR was lodged on 17.08.2023 and at that time the age of the victim was 28 years, whereas, they were maintaining relationship from 25.12.2016 till 20.06.2023; the victim is a grown up and educated lady and she was well aware of the pros and cons of such relationship and they stayed for a considerable period in rented house, I feel inclined to allow this application.
6. Accordingly, the anticipatory bail application filed under Section 438 of the Cr.P.C. is allowed.
The observations made in the course of this order are only for considering the case of the applicant for grant of anticipatory bail.
The concerned trial Court shall not be influenced or bound by any observations made hereinabove.

6. Accordingly, the anticipatory bail application filed under Section 438 of the Cr.P.C. is allowed.
It is directed that in the event of the applicant executing a personal bond for a sum of Rs.50,000/- to the satisfaction of the concerned arresting officer, he shall be released on bail, on following conditions:-

(iii) that he shall not act, in any manner, which will be prejudicial to fair and expeditious trial; and (iv) that he shall appear before the trial Court on each and every date given to him by the said Court till disposal of the trial.
